### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report all numerical values and their units precisely as stated in the transcript. Do not perform unit conversions or infer derived numerical data (e.g., temperature conversions) unless explicitly provided in the source text.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report all numerical values and their units *exactly* as stated in the transcript. *Strictly avoid* performing unit conversions or inferring derived numerical data (e.g., temperature conversions) *unless the converted value is explicitly mentioned in the conversation*.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
